_readme: Pre-loaded class history so the teacher dashboard is NOT EMPTY on demo day.
An empty dashboard looks broken even when it is working correctly.
seed.py creates synthetic students, gives them gaps and confirmed misconception
diagnoses in these proportions, then the live demo adds one more on top - so the
heatmap has a believable shape AND visibly increments when the student confirms.
Synthetic students are never named in any teacher view; teacher endpoints only

reteach_units.title: Constant velocity means zero net force
reteach_units.body: Start from the observation that a puck on ice keeps moving with no push at all. Motion does not need a force; only a CHANGE in motion does. Work through the sliding block at constant speed: the push and friction are equal and opposite, so they sum to zero.
